notes: kb/Work PB5925 (listing step 4a of docs/rearchitecture/DESIGN-listing.md, 2026-11-18). §2023:7.3.19.4 GR3: "If a source listing is not being produced, a PAGE directive shall have no effect." With no listing the driver records nothing for a PAGE directive (it asks TextStageTrace.Records first) and consumes the line as a blank one, so the program compiles and runs as without the directive: the goldens pb725_directive_facility (2002) and pb794_directive_operands (2023) hold >>PAGE with directive-independent expected output. At --std 85 a >>PAGE line is COBOL0900 (COBOL-85 has no >> directives).
